Isn't there a way to just write a script that forces the toon lit shader to be overlaid by standard shading as a workaround, until the bug is fixed?

I recently got a HTC Vive and a new RX 580 and played for days with my old i5-4460 for days with no problems. Then I decided to upgrade my computer and got new everything including a new AMD cpu and then this problem happened. I installed old drivers for RX 580 off of a CD, I would have assumed it would have updated online though. This time I did not install through CD so for sure have most current version. It's either a problem with the processor or graphics drives, and it's probably drives as someone else pointed out. I'll have to test downgrading to an older version tomorrow.

From my understanding, this is an issue with the way Cubed's shader creates the outline on avatars. It's not related to VRChat, it's something that AMD broke in their drivers (the Jan 2017 AMD driver still works). There is a recently released version of Cubed's shader that doesn't have the outline option, which will display correctly for users with AMD GPUs. Past that, this is not something VRChat can fix on their end.

details:
After the latest update, for some reason, now avatars who have a shader (So far its been Flat Lit Tooner) disappear and I'm not alone, as the avatars and others will not appear again unless the game is restarted, and even then it happens again. My shoes aren't Flat Lit so I know its the shader. Some are saying its related to the AMD, but we haven't found the source, so it is most likely from the Games coding possibly? I tried re-uploading with the new SDK and the same thing happened. ANY help as to why this is happening would be greatly appreciated so I can help the others.

Graphics Card is ; AMD RX 570 series
title: Avatars (Mine as well) Disappearing, Bug w/ Flat Lit Shader or AMD.
